description: Send messages and inspect health and version information for a Gotify server.

auth.label: Application Token
auth.description: Gotify application token sent with the X-Gotify-Key header. In the Gotify WebUI, open Apps, create or select an application, and copy its token: https://gotify.net/docs/pushmsg.

extraFields.label: Server Base URL
extraFields.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of your Gotify server. Public addresses work by default; private-network instances require the self-hosted runtime to enable OOMOL_CONNECT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK. Unsafe local, reserved, and cloud-metadata targets remain blocked.

actions.name: get_health
actions.description: Fetch health information from the connected Gotify instance.

inputSchema.description: This action does not require any input parameters.

health.description: The overall Gotify application health value.

actions.name: get_version
actions.description: Fetch version information from the connected Gotify instance.

inputSchema.description: This action does not require any input parameters.

commit.description: The git commit hash used to build the Gotify server.

buildDate.description: The date when the Gotify server binary was built.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Send a message through the connected Gotify application token and return the created message.

message.description: The message body to send. Markdown excluding HTML is allowed.

title.description: An optional title for the Gotify message.

priority.description: An optional message priority. If omitted, Gotify uses the application default priority.

extras.description: Optional Gotify message extras keyed by the official namespace format.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for creating one Gotify message.

appid.description: The id of the Gotify application that sent this message.

message.description: The Gotify message body. Markdown excluding HTML is allowed.

date.description: The date and time when the message was created.

extras.description: Optional Gotify message extras keyed by the official namespace format.

outputSchema.description: A Gotify message returned by the REST API.
